to.description: Agent handle, with or without @. Example: @alpha.

handoff_id.description: Optional hnd_... id this agreement is about. Example: hnd_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001

terms.description: The typed terms: goal, done_means, kinds, time_box_minutes, budget_messages. Example: {"goal": "Review the checkout PR", "done_means": ["Findings listed"], "kinds": ["review"], "time_box_minutes": 1440, "budget_messages": 50}
